title: Summit — Free Bootstrap 6 Conference & Event Website Template
excerpt: A free Bootstrap 6 conference template — oversized marquee hero, live countdown, day-tabbed schedule table, speakers, tickets and a fixed booking bar.
yoastTitle: Summit — Free Bootstrap 6 Conference & Event Website Template
yoastDesc: Free Bootstrap 6 conference and event template with a live countdown, day-tabbed schedule table, speaker grid, ticket tiers and a checkout dialog using Combobox and Chip input.
intro: Summit is a free, premium Bootstrap 6 template for conferences, meetups and multi-day events. It leads with an oversized marquee headline and a live countdown, then gets straight to the two things attendees came for: who is speaking and what is on when.
note: The signature detail is the booking bar: instead of a header button that scrolls away, the primary call to action is fixed to the bottom of the viewport with live ticket counts. The schedule is a real accessible table tabbed by day, and the checkout dialog uses Combobox for ticket and workshop selection plus Chip input for dietary requirements.
summary: Summit is a free, premium Bootstrap 6 conference template. Near-black canvas with a single electric accent, an oversized marquee hero, a live JavaScript countdown, a speaker grid, a day-tabbed accessible schedule table, ticket tiers, venue and accessibility detail, and an FAQ. The primary CTA is a fixed bottom booking bar, and the checkout dialog uses Combobox and Chip input. ESM-only vanilla JavaScript, no build step.
features: Oversized marquee hero with a bordered date block and live countdown
Fixed bottom ticket bar as the primary CTA, with live remaining count
Day-tabbed schedule built as a real accessible <table> with captions and scopes
Speaker grid with gradient name overlays
Three ticket tiers with a highlighted recommendation
Checkout dialog using Combobox for ticket and workshop choice, Chip input for dietary needs
Venue section with genuine accessibility detail, and an FAQ on native <details>
Dark by default, light mode included via data-bs-theme
ScrollSpy navigation offset for the sticky header
Native form validation with data-bs-validate and :user-invalid
ESM-only vanilla JavaScript — no jQuery, no bundler, no build step
